request.subject: PORTRAIT:CANDY:BATTLESHIP

layers.text: Turn it into a layered-cake galleon: the hull becomes layers of pale cream sponge cake #f3dfb8 with pale pink frosting #ffb8d8 dripping from its top edge; the grey castles become round cake towers with white whipped cream on top; the red sails become white cream sails; the masts become pink and white striped candy canes; the pennants pale pink. Nothing red. Keep the ship shape, size, thick black outline and art style the same, on a transparent background.
